identity.subject_id: Opaque stable subject identifier; non-empty, trimmed and consistent across all three observations

time.recording_clock_rule: observed_at and recorded_at are separate timestamps; compare observed_at only with observed_at and recorded_at only with recorded_at; never compare the two clock streams to each other

minimum_delay.meaning: Finite protocol boundary for this candidate only; not a universal or optimal spacing recommendation

requirements.P09.RQ01: 即时、延迟与陌生任务迁移观察必须携带同一typed learner/subject identity对象；对象包含稳定subject_id与identity_version，三者精确相等；身份相等仅是协议绑定，不是现实身份认证。
requirements.P09.RQ02: 三个观察的event time采用UTC epoch seconds与SECOND单位；recorded_at独立记录，保持自身时基/单位与追加顺序；不得将event time与recorded_at跨时钟比较。
requirements.P09.RQ03: 延迟间隔由delayed.observed_at减immediate.observed_at计算，至少86400秒；novel transfer observed_at严格晚于delayed；caller delay_positive和caller minimum_delay_seconds均不构成证据。
requirements.P09.RQ04: 保留即时、延迟、迁移各自结果及失败/未知状态；迁移必须是不同任务族且目标维度明确；本候选阈值不是普遍或最优间隔建议。
